entities.name: Diethyl benzamide diester substrate
observations: Decoded substrate is a benzene bearing one N-methyl-N-propyl benzamide and two ethyl ester groups.

entities.name: Mono-saponified benzamide acid
observations: Plausible isolated product is selective hydrolysis of one ethyl ester to a carboxylic acid while retaining the other ethyl ester and tertiary amide.

entities.name: Ethanolic sodium hydroxide hydrolysis
observations: Ethanol, hydroxide, sodium, and chloride/HCl components are consistent with basic ester saponification followed by acidification during workup.
Before acidification, the hydrolyzed ester is predominantly the sodium carboxylate; the isolated product is the neutral carboxylic acid.
